cases.sentence: Он стер его в порошок и развеял на ___.
cases.explain: «общенародном кладбище» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

cases.sentence: Еще он разрушил дома, которые находились при доме Господа, где жили ___ и где женщины ткали для Ашеры.
cases.explain: «храмовые блудники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in Yahweh’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.

cases.sentence: Он разрушил святилища на возвышенностях при воротах — при входе в ворота Иисуса, правителя города, слева от ___.
cases.explain: «городских ворот» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

cases.sentence: Он сокрушил жертвенники, которые цари Иудеи воздвигли на крыше ___ Ахаза, и жертвенники, которые Манассия построил в двух дворах дома Господа.
cases.explain: «верхней комнаты» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of Yahweh’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.

cases.sentence: Иосия разбил на куски священные камни, срубил столбы Ашеры и покрыл их место ___.
cases.explain: «человеческими костями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.

cases.sentence: После этого Иосия поглядел вокруг и, увидев могилы на склоне холма, велел вынуть из них кости и сжечь их на жертвеннике, чтобы осквернить его, по слову Господа, сказанному ___, который предрек все это.
cases.explain: «Божьим человеком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to Yahweh’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.

cases.sentence: Еще Иосия уничтожил вызывателей мертвых и чародеев, ___, идолов и все прочие мерзости, которые нашлись в Иудее и в Иерусалиме.
cases.explain: «домашних божков» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Moreover Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in Yahweh’s house.

cases.sentence: ___ правления Иосии и все, что он сделал, то разве не записаны они в «Книге летописей царей Иудеи»?
cases.explain: «Прочие события» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
